name: Pokédex
description: Search Pokémon by name or browse a searchable list with stats and official artwork.
template:
<Stack gap="md">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="wrap">
    <Group gap="sm" align="center"><Icon name="star-filled" /><Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} size="lg">Pokédex</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Explore Pokémon by name, type, and stats</Text></Stack></Group>
    <Group gap="xs"><Badge color="red" variant="light">{data.pokemonList?.count ?? 0} species</Badge><RefreshButton requestId="pokemonList" label="Refresh list" /></Group>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="sm">
    <Group justify="space-between" align="center"><Text fw={600}>Browse loaded list</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.pokemonList?.results?.length ?? 0} loaded</Text></Group>
    <Select bind="selectedName" label="Search and choose a Pokémon" placeholder="Type a name or select one" searchable clearable nothingFoundMessage="No loaded Pokémon match" data={(data.pokemonList?.results ?? []).map((pokemon) => pokemon.name)} />
    <TextInput bind="directName" label="Direct name lookup" placeholder="Any Pokédex name, e.g. pikachu" />
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap="sm">
    <Text fw={600}>Selected Pokémon</Text>
    {inputs.selectedName ? <SubFetch requestId="pokemonDetail" trigger="manual" params={{name: inputs.selectedName}} loadingLabel="Loading selected Pokémon…" errorMessage="Could not load this Pokémon. Try again." triggerAriaLabel="Load selected Pokémon details" triggerContent={<Text c="red" fw={600}>Open selected Pokémon</Text>}>
      {(pokemon) => <Card withBorder radius="md" p="md"><Stack gap="sm"><Group gap="sm" align="center">{pokemon.sprites?.other?.["official-artwork"]?.front_default ? <Image src={pokemon.sprites.other["official-artwork"].front_default} alt={pokemon.name} w={88} h={88} fit="contain" /> : <Icon name="star-filled" />}<Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} tt="capitalize">#{pokemon.id} {pokemon.name}</Text><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Height {pokemon.height / 10} m · Weight {pokemon.weight / 10} kg</Text></Stack></Group><Group gap="xs">{(pokemon.types ?? []).map((entry) => <Badge key={entry.slot} color="red" variant="light" tt="capitalize">{entry.type.name}</Badge>)}</Group><Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Abilities</Text><Group gap="xs">{(pokemon.abilities ?? []).map((entry) => <Badge key={entry.ability.name} color="gray" variant="outline" tt="capitalize">{entry.ability.name}{entry.is_hidden ? " · hidden" : ""}</Badge>)}</Group></Stack><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Base stats</Text><Stack gap="xs">{(pokemon.stats ?? []).map((entry) => <Stack key={entry.stat.name} gap={0}><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" tt="capitalize">{entry.stat.name}</Text><Text size="xs">{entry.base_stat}</Text></Group><Progress value={Math.min((entry.base_stat / 255) * 100, 100)} color="red" size="sm" /></Stack>)}</Stack></Stack></Card>}
    </SubFetch> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Choose a Pokémon from the loaded list to see its details here.</Text>}
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap="sm">
    <Text fw={600}>Direct lookup result</Text>
    {inputs.directName ? <SubFetch requestId="pokemonDetail" trigger="manual" params={{name: inputs.directName}} loadingLabel="Looking up Pokémon…" errorMessage="No Pokémon found for that name. Check spelling and retry." triggerAriaLabel="Look up Pokémon by name" triggerContent={<Text c="red" fw={600}>Look up typed name</Text>}>
      {(pokemon) => <Card withBorder radius="md" p="md"><Stack gap="sm"><Group gap="sm" align="center">{pokemon.sprites?.other?.["official-artwork"]?.front_default ? <Image src={pokemon.sprites.other["official-artwork"].front_default} alt={pokemon.name} w={88} h={88} fit="contain" /> : <Icon name="star-filled" />}<Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} tt="capitalize">#{pokemon.id} {pokemon.name}</Text><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Height {pokemon.height / 10} m · Weight {pokemon.weight / 10} kg</Text></Stack></Group><Group gap="xs">{(pokemon.types ?? []).map((entry) => <Badge key={entry.slot} color="red" variant="light" tt="capitalize">{entry.type.name}</Badge>)}</Group><Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Abilities</Text><Group gap="xs">{(pokemon.abilities ?? []).map((entry) => <Badge key={entry.ability.name} color="gray" variant="outline" tt="capitalize">{entry.ability.name}{entry.is_hidden ? " · hidden" : ""}</Badge>)}</Group></Stack><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Base stats</Text><Stack gap="xs">{(pokemon.stats ?? []).map((entry) => <Stack key={entry.stat.name} gap={0}><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" tt="capitalize">{entry.stat.name}</Text><Text size="xs">{entry.base_stat}</Text></Group><Progress value={Math.min((entry.base_stat / 255) * 100, 100)} color="red" size="sm" /></Stack>)}</Stack></Stack></Card>}
    </SubFetch> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Enter any Pokémon name above to begin a direct lookup.</Text>}
  </Stack>
  {status.pokemonList?.loading ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Loading the Pokédex list…</Text> : null}
  {status.pokemonList && !status.pokemonList.ok ? <Text size="sm" c="red">Could not load names ({status.pokemonList.statusText ?? status.pokemonList.status ?? "request failed"}). Refresh to retry.</Text> : null}
  {data.pokemonList?.results && data.pokemonList.results.length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No Pokémon returned for this list range.</Text> : null}
  {!data.pokemonList && !status.pokemonList?.loading && status.pokemonList?.ok !== false ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Your Pokédex list will appear here once loaded.</Text> : null}
</Stack>
